function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. To get the current temperature in Moscow (in Celsius), you can check a reliable weather website or app such as the Weather Channel, AccuWeather, or a local Russian weather service. If you’d like, I can help you find a suitable source or guide you on how to look it up.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What wheather is now in Moscow, in celsius?" They want current weather in Moscow in Celsius. We need to provide current temperature. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we can't fetch real-time. But we can use a weather API? There's no tool for that. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest using a weather service. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Provide approximate? We can say it's around X degrees but uncertain. Better to say we can't fetch.
